title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

translated_title: 回归开发状态：完整沙箱快照何时能帮助编码智能体
translated_abstract: 编码智能体在失败之前往往会取得有用的进展，但从头重试会丢弃在此过程中创建的机器状态。这使得故障恢复成为一个有趣的搜索问题：如果中间环境状态保留了有意义的进展，从这些状态恢复并分支可能优于从初始状态反复重启。我们在完整的 Daytona 快照上实现了 Go-Explore 风格的搜索，发现更高且更高效的解决率主要依赖于位于代码仓库之外的进展，例如数据库、服务和其他运行时状态。我们的结果表明，当长周期的编码工作跨越多个服务、且其状态无法从单个 diff 重建时，完整快照搜索最为有效。
tldr: 基于完整沙箱快照的 Go-Explore 式搜索可以提升编码智能体的解决率与效率，其效果主要依赖于代码仓库之外的状态（如数据库、服务及其他运行时状态）。
en_tdlr: Go-Explore-style search over full sandbox snapshots improves coding agents' solve rates and efficiency, with gains driven mainly by progress outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state.
